name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking by DXY Regime: BRL, MXN, ZAR
description: Monthly carry-to-vol score ranking for 3 EM currencies vs USD, split by DXY regime. Carry = (EM discount rate − Fed Funds) / 12 via FRED. Realized vol = 30-day rolling annualized std of daily log returns. Carry-to-vol = carry / vol, ranked cross-sectionally each month. DXY regime defined by 3-month rolling return of Trade Weighted USD Broad Index (DTWEXBGS): weakening (return < 0) vs strengthening (>= 0). Shows next-month forward FX returns for top-ranked vs bottom-ranked currencies, broken down by USD regime.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# =============================================================================
# Monthly carry-to-vol score for 3 EM currencies vs USD:
#   Carry = (EM discount rate - Fed Funds rate) / 12
#   Vol = 30-day rolling annualized realized vol (std of log returns * sqrt(252))
#   Score = carry / vol -> higher = more carry per unit risk
# Cross-sectional ranking at month-end; next-month forward FX returns
# FX convention: USDBRL/USDMXN/USDZAR -> rising = EM weakening
#   Forward returns inverted so positive = EM appreciation
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# INTEREST RATE DATA (FRED)
# =============================================================================
# EM discount rates (monthly, % per annum) and US Fed Funds rate
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTDSRBRM193N")()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTDSRMXM193N")()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTDSRZAM193N")()
usd_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="FEDFUNDS")()

# Forward-fill sparse monthly data to daily frequency
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# DXY DATA (FRED: Trade Weighted USD Broad Index)
# =============================================================================
dxy_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DTWEXBGS")()
dxy = ffill(dxy_raw.result)

# 3-month rolling return of DXY (63 calendar days ~ 3 months)
dxy_3m_ago = calendar_shift(period=63D)(dxy)
dxy_3m_ret = (dxy - dxy_3m_ago) / dxy_3m_ago

# DXY regime: weakening (3m return < 0) vs strengthening (>= 0)
weak_usd = dxy_3m_ret < 0

# =============================================================================
# ASSIGN EM RATE TO EACH ASSET USING is_asset_ref
# =============================================================================
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDBRL")()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDMXN")()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDZAR")()

# Each asset gets its own EM interest rate
em_rate = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_rate, is_mxn, mxn_rate, is_zar, zar_rate, 0.0)

# Monthly carry = (EM rate - USD rate) / 12, rates are in % per annum
# Divide by 100 to convert from percentage to decimal, then by 12 for monthly
monthly_carry = (em_rate - usd_rate) / 1200.0

# =============================================================================
# REALIZED VOLATILITY: 30-day rolling annualized vol of daily log returns
# =============================================================================
log_ret = returns(type=ReturnsType.log)(close)
real_vol = stddev(period=30)(log_ret) * sqrt(252)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL SCORE
# =============================================================================
carry_to_vol = monthly_carry / real_vol

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANKING (1 = best carry-to-vol, 3 = worst)
# Ascending=False so rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol
# =============================================================================
rank_val = cs_rank(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS: Next-month log return, inverted (positive = EM appreciation)
# ~21 trading days in a month
# =============================================================================
fwd_ret_raw = forward_returns(period=21, return_type=ReturnType.log)(close)
fwd_ret = -1.0 * fwd_ret_raw

# =============================================================================
# MONTH-END SNAPSHOTS FOR ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
is_month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(bar_idx)

# Snapshot carry-to-vol and rank at month-end
monthly_ctv = where(is_month_end, carry_to_vol)
monthly_rank = where(is_month_end, rank_val)
monthly_fwd = where(is_month_end, fwd_ret)

# Top-ranked (rank=1) and bottom-ranked (rank=3) monthly forward returns
is_top = is_month_end and (rank_val == 1)
is_bottom = is_month_end and (rank_val == 3)

top_fwd = where(is_top, fwd_ret)
bottom_fwd = where(is_bottom, fwd_ret)

# Hit rates: positive forward return when top/bottom ranked
top_positive = where(is_top, fwd_ret > 0)
bottom_positive = where(is_bottom, fwd_ret > 0)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME-SPLIT FORWARD RETURNS AT MONTH-END
# =============================================================================
# Tag regime at each month-end
month_end_weak = is_month_end and weak_usd
month_end_strong = is_month_end and (weak_usd == False)

# Top-ranked (rank=1) forward return split by regime
is_top_weak = is_top and weak_usd
is_top_strong = is_top and (weak_usd == False)
top_fwd_weak = where(is_top_weak, fwd_ret)
top_fwd_strong = where(is_top_strong, fwd_ret)

# Bottom-ranked (rank=3) forward return split by regime
is_bottom_weak = is_bottom and weak_usd
is_bottom_strong = is_bottom and (weak_usd == False)
bottom_fwd_weak = where(is_bottom_weak, fwd_ret)
bottom_fwd_strong = where(is_bottom_strong, fwd_ret)

# Hit rates by regime (% positive forward return)
top_hit_weak = where(is_top_weak, fwd_ret > 0)
top_hit_strong = where(is_top_strong, fwd_ret > 0)
bottom_hit_weak = where(is_bottom_weak, fwd_ret > 0)
bottom_hit_strong = where(is_bottom_strong, fwd_ret > 0)

# Month counts per regime (for summary)
weak_month_flag = where(is_month_end, weak_usd)
strong_month_flag = where(month_end_strong, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# 1. CS Lines: Carry-to-Vol Score over time
cs_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Score by Currency',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_idx, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# 2. CS Lines: 30-day Realized Vol over time
cs_lines(
    title='30-Day Annualized Realized Vol',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_idx, y_values=real_vol)

# 3. XY Bars (per asset): Monthly next-month returns colored by value
xy_bars(
    title='Next-Month FX Return (Positive = EM Appreciation)',
    category='Monthly Returns',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    y_axis_label='Log Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=monthly_fwd, label=monthly_rank)

# 4. CS Summary Table: Performance by rank
cs_summary_table(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Ranking: Top vs Bottom Performance',
    category='EM Carry Ranking',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Carry-to-Vol Ranking Stats',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Next-Mo Return (Top Rank)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Next-Mo Return (Bottom Rank)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate Top (% Positive)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate Bottom (% Positive)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Carry-to-Vol Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(top_fwd, bottom_fwd, top_positive, bottom_positive, carry_to_vol)

# 5. CS Lines: DXY 3-Month Rolling Return (above 0 = strong USD, below 0 = weak USD)
cs_lines(
    title='DXY 3-Month Rolling Return (Regime Indicator)',
    category='DXY Regime',
    y_axis_label='3-Month Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=4
)(x_values=bar_idx, y_values=dxy_3m_ret)

# 6. CS Summary Table: Regime-split performance breakdown
cs_summary_table(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Performance by DXY Regime',
    category='DXY Regime',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Top vs Bottom Rank × Weak vs Strong USD',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return: Top/Weak USD', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return: Top/Strong USD', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return: Bottom/Weak USD', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Return: Bottom/Strong USD', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate: Top/Weak', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate: Top/Strong', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate: Bottom/Weak', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate: Bottom/Strong', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Weak USD Months', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Strong USD Months', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum)
        ]
    ),
    order=5
)(top_fwd_weak, top_fwd_strong, bottom_fwd_weak, bottom_fwd_strong, top_hit_weak, top_hit_strong, bottom_hit_weak, bottom_hit_strong, weak_month_flag, strong_month_flag)
